First to 7 wins. Press start to rally!

How to play

Keep the ball in play and send it past the other paddle. First to 7 points wins.

  • Player 1: W / S
  • Player 2: ↑ / ↓

Choose your rally

One player mode serves up a friendly computer opponent. Tap mode for local two player.

Tip: paddle edges send the ball at sharper angles.
